Package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.persistence

package br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.infrastructure.persistence
The storage adapters: one CSV, one PostgreSQL and one in-memory implementation of each port in application.port.

The CSV files live under data/; PostgreSQL is reached through plain JDBC, with no object-relational mapper, and creates its tables on first use. Which one a run uses is decided once, in bootstrap.Storage. These classes know the domain; the domain does not know them.
